messages:
jason: Quick repro: app background + toggle wifi a few times on Pixel 4a. ConnectionPool total keeps increasing. Using Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.11. Any quick ideas?

priya: I've seen the eviction ScheduledExecutor stop firing when device dozes. Idle sockets stick around.

michael: Also check our coroutine cancellation wiring. If call.cancel isn't run synchronously, queued callbacks can keep references and prevent GC.

jason: Logs snippet:

```
I/OkHttp: ConnectionPool: total=20 idle=20
W/Network: Socket closed during idle check
E/OkHttp: Failed to find writable socket for https://api.redwood.test
```

priya: Workarounds: 1) run connectionPool.evictAll() on resume/connect change, 2) do a small warmup ping on resume. Both are imperfect (evictAll causes reconnect spike).

michael: We added a small cancel-guard in the coroutine adapter: set a volatile flag on cancel so late callbacks are ignored. Also added a test hook to force a cleanup in unit tests.

jason: Can we add a tiny emulator sample to devex/samples that toggles connectivity and asserts pool size stays under threshold? Would help CI catch regressions.

android-ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4321 for sample + integration test.

priya: I'll file a small PR that reschedules the eviction task on ACTION_SCREEN_ON and exposes the test hook. michael: can you add the cancel-guard and a unit test?

michael: On it. Will avoid evictAll on every event; only when socket errors exceed a threshold.

jason: Thanks — assigning follow-ups and will coordinate canary rollout after green CI. :thumbsup:
